definitions.explanation: The natural desire or craving for food.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}を{引|ひ}いて{食欲|しょくよく}がない。
examples.english: I have no appetite because I caught a cold.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}は{食欲|しょくよく}の{秋|あき}と{言|い}われる。
examples.english: Fall is said to be the season of appetite.
examples.notes: Common Japanese expression associating autumn with good eating

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}したら{食欲|しょくよく}が{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: After exercising, I developed an appetite.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}い{日|ひ}が{続|つづ}くと{食欲|しょくよく}が{落|お}ちてしまう。
examples.english: When hot days continue, my appetite drops.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}が{治|なお}ってから{食欲|しょくよく}が{戻|もど}って、{何|なに}を{食|た}べても{美味|おい}しく{感|かん}じるようになった。
examples.english: After recovering from my illness, my appetite returned and everything I eat tastes delicious.

notes:
{食欲|しょくよく} specifically refers to appetite for food.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {食欲|しょくよく}がある (to have an appetite)
- {食欲|しょくよく}がない (to have no appetite)
- {食欲|しょくよく}が{出|で}る (appetite returns/develops)
- {食欲|しょくよく}をそそる (to whet one's appetite)
- {食欲|しょくよく}が{落|お}ちる (appetite decreases)
- {食欲|しょくよく}の{秋|あき} (autumn, the season of appetite)

RELATED:
- {食欲|しょくよく}{不振|ふしん} (loss of appetite, poor appetite)
